clips.title: The story
paras: Camping 101: Skinning instructs wilderness travelers on how to craft their own portable Camp Chair. It emphasizes the fundamentals of outdoor survival, reminding adventurers that a proper campsite requires venturing away from town and starting a campfire.

Camping 101: Skinning introduces outdoorsmen and skinners to the craft of wilderness survival. By putting harvested hides and materials to practical use, travelers learn to construct a portable Camp Chair for their journeys. Rather than cluttering bustling city centers where locals object to pitched camps, adventurers are expected to take their craft out into the open wilds of Azeroth.

No campsite in the wild is functional without a warming campfire. Establishing a camp requires a fire to be laid first, offering heat and shelter against the elements. Novice survivalists who have not yet picked up basic culinary skills are encouraged to visit a cooking trainer, who can instruct them in the fundamental craft of kindling a fire anywhere in the field.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Being able to skillfully harvest the skins and hides of fallen beasts is one of the more valuable skills an adventurer can possess.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Camp Chair for your camp. Sometimes it's important to just take a load off, and you can use some of those hides you've gathered to make a comfy chair to sit in. A bit of relaxation can help ensure that you are at your peak condition and can strike where it counts the next time you find yourself in a dust-up.

clips.title: Completion
paras: There you have it, you can now craft your very own Camp Chair. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
